title: LEOPs ERG/OPs ASD 通道级对比分析 (ERG 通道家族化模式 #126)

data_source.name: Light-Adapted ERG and Oscillatory Potentials (LEOPs) Dataset for ASD
data_source.contents: LEOPs_dataset.xlsx (5 sheets: 9_step 4246 wf/173 ppl, 2_step 415 wf/61 ppl, LA3 648 wf/217 ppl, 2 participant sheets) + jsons/ (253 participant-level JSON) + ImagesERG/ (558 PNG, 244 ppl)
data_source.participants: 253 total (157 TD, 75 ASD, 21 ASD+ADHD), 2 sites: Flinders U (AU) + UCL (UK), RETeval handheld, skin electrodes
data_source.waveforms: 5309 ERG + 4434 OPs (85-195 Hz band-pass); 9-step photopic hill 12-446 Td.s, 2-step 113/446 Td.s, LA3 85 Td.s (ISCEV)
data_source.clinical_features: a/b wave amplitude+implicit time, summed OPs, FSIQ, CARS, ASD severity, age, sex, site, electrode position graded
data_source.note: arXiv 2604.16981 摘要中样本计数 (2500/1730/451) 与 Mendeley 页 (5309 ERG waveforms/253 participants) 口径不同: 前者似为逐次原始波形计数, 后者为平均波形; 以 Mendeley 数据本体为准
